godel.why: static checks of the program's text (GODEL_AUDIT §4.3: selfcheck, integrity NO)

name: boundaries

pipeline.tier_reason: the program's text is scanned whole for source-folder references and publishing calls: exhaustive over the files, blind to what they compute

statement: Self-contained and private by default: the runtime needs no source folder, and nothing publishes (no push, no upload) unless asked.
usefulness: The program is one folder you own; it never sends your work anywhere by itself.
